title: Заказы за 2025-03-15
sql:
SELECT id, user_id, total
FROM orders
WHERE DATE(created_at) = '2025-03-15'
ORDER BY id

title: Последние заказы «delivered» за 2022
sql:
SELECT id, user_id, total, created_at
FROM orders
WHERE YEAR(created_at) = 2022 AND status = 'delivered'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 50

title: Статистика клиентов, Томск
sql:
SELECT u.id, u.name,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id) AS orders_count,
  (SELECT SUM(o.total) FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id) AS orders_sum
FROM users u
WHERE u.city = 'Томск'
ORDER BY u.id

title: Клиенты без заказов «cancelled»
sql:
SELECT id, email
FROM users
WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled')
ORDER BY id
LIMIT 100

title: Активные клиенты с 2026-01-01, Казань
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT u.id, u.email
FROM users u
JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id
WHERE o.created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND u.city = 'Казань'
ORDER BY u.id

title: Поиск клиента по email или телефону (500)
sql:
SELECT id, name, email, phone
FROM users
WHERE email = 'user500@mail.ru' OR phone = '+79000000501'

title: Страница заказов, OFFSET 450000
sql:
SELECT id, user_id, total
FROM orders
ORDER BY id
LIMIT 20 OFFSET 450000

title: Крупнейший заказ клиентов 1–1500
sql:
SELECT o.user_id, o.id, o.total
FROM orders o
WHERE o.user_id BETWEEN 1 AND 1500
  AND o.total = (SELECT MAX(o2.total) FROM orders o2 WHERE o2.user_id = o.user_id)
ORDER BY o.user_id, o.id

title: Заказы клиента
sql:
SELECT id, status, total, created_at
FROM orders
WHERE user_id = 31337
ORDER BY created_at

title: Отчёт по категориям, refunded 2025
sql:
SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'refunded' AND YEAR(o.created_at) = 2025
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY revenue DESC
